Model card: Woof Selector 4B 4-bit v2.1 **Choose the next action. Keep browser tasks moving.** Woof Selector is a compact, local browser-use model. Given a task, the current page context and available choices, it selects the next operation and target. Quantization-aware training adapts the model for 4-bit deployment. Woof Selector is built on Qwen3.5-4B through browser-focused post-training. **The selector decides what to do and where; the text filler supplies what to type.** Single-step validation The QAT model achieved **96.6% decision acceptance (516/534)** on fixed browser-state validation, evaluated using an LLM-as-judge. Valid alternative actions were accepted. End-to-end browser evaluation 10 public tasks Woof runs use our selector and text fillers on Apple Silicon. Original Qwen results are also our measurements.
